fallback.headline: Your progress so far
fallback.body: Blink Eye is free and open source. Premium unlocks themes, multi-monitor, and keeps the project alive.

daysLeftNote.one: You have {{count}} day of premium left — make it count.
daysLeftNote.other: You have {{count}} days of premium left — make them count.

hero.startedHere: Every habit starts somewhere — yours started here.

ms-streak-5.headline: 5-day streak — that's a habit 🌟
ms-streak-5.body: Most people never make it past day two. Premium is our high-five back: themes, multi-monitor, and keeping Blink Eye free for everyone.

ms-streak-10.headline: Double digits: {streak} days! 🎉
ms-streak-10.body: {streak} days of looking away on purpose. That's discipline. Going premium supports the open-source project behind your streak.

ms-streak-30.headline: {streak} days. A full month of kinder eyes 🏆
ms-streak-30.body: A whole month of showing up for yourself. Premium members keep this free for the next person starting day one.

ms-club-50.headline: {totalBreaks} full breaks together 💛
ms-club-50.body: That's the 50-break club — {totalBreaks} times you chose your eyes over your screen. Premium is how you keep the club running.

ms-club-100.headline: {totalBreaks} breaks. Triple digits! 🌟
ms-club-100.body: One hundred times you paused on purpose. Blink Eye is free and open source — premium keeps it that way.

ms-club-250.headline: {totalBreaks} breaks. Legend status 🏆
ms-club-250.body: Few people ever reach {totalBreaks} full breaks. You're the reason this project exists — premium is the tip jar.

te-streak-1.headline: Look at you, {streak} days in a row 🎉
te-streak-1.body: That's a real habit forming.{daysLeftNote} Premium keeps your toolkit sharp — themes, multi-monitor, and more.

te-streak-2.headline: {streak}-day streak — your eyes thank you
te-streak-2.body: Keep it rolling.{daysLeftNote} Going premium supports Blink Eye and unlocks everything.

te-cum-1.headline: {totalBreaks} breaks together 💛
te-cum-1.body: That's {totalBreaks} times you chose your eyes.{daysLeftNote} Premium keeps Blink Eye free for everyone.

te-cum-2.headline: You've shown up {totalBreaks} times
te-cum-2.body: Consistency like that deserves the full toolkit.{daysLeftNote} Themes, multi-monitor, and our thanks.

te-rel-1.headline: {screenHours} hours of screen time today
te-rel-1.body: And you still looked away. That's the whole game.{daysLeftNote} Premium helps us keep it going.

te-fb-1.headline: Your trial is almost up
te-fb-1.body: Thanks for spending these days with us.{daysLeftNote} Blink Eye is free and open source — premium keeps it that way.

te-fb-2.headline: A little note before your trial ends
te-fb-2.body: No pressure, just thanks.{daysLeftNote} If Blink Eye helped your eyes, premium is how you help the project back.

ex-streak-1.headline: {streak}-day streak and counting 🎉
ex-streak-1.body: Your trial ended, but your habit doesn't have to. Support Blink Eye to unlock premium extras.

ex-streak-2.headline: {streak} days of showing up for your eyes
ex-streak-2.body: That streak is yours, trial or not. Premium is how you keep the project behind it alive.

ex-cum-1.headline: {totalBreaks} breaks — look how far you've come 💛
ex-cum-1.body: Every one of those was a gift to your future self. Premium keeps the gifts coming, for you and everyone.

ex-cum-2.headline: You've taken {totalBreaks} proper breaks
ex-cum-2.body: Not many people can say that. Unlock themes and multi-monitor — and keep Blink Eye free for all.

ex-rel-1.headline: {screenHours} hours in front of a screen today
ex-rel-1.body: Good thing someone reminds you to look away. That someone runs on premium support.

ex-fb-1.headline: Your trial ended — your breaks don't have to
ex-fb-1.body: Blink Eye stays free, trial or not. Premium just unlocks extras and supports the project.

ex-fb-2.headline: Still here, still blinking 💛
ex-fb-2.body: Day one of the rest of your (well-rested) eyes. Premium is there whenever you want it.

wb-streak-1.headline: {streak} days straight — we noticed 🎉
wb-streak-1.body: We missed you around here. Premium is still yours whenever you want it — and it keeps Blink Eye free.

wb-streak-2.headline: That {streak}-day streak suits you
wb-streak-2.body: Come back to the full toolkit: themes, multi-monitor, and the warm feeling of supporting open source.

wb-cum-1.headline: {totalBreaks} breaks and counting 💛
wb-cum-1.body: You've been at this a while — respect. Premium is our way of saying thanks back.

wb-cum-2.headline: Remember your first break?
wb-cum-2.body: You've taken {totalBreaks} since then. Premium keeps the next {totalBreaks} coming — for you and for free.

wb-rel-1.headline: {screenHours} screen hours today — same as ever
wb-rel-1.body: Some things never change, and that's why we're still here. Premium keeps us here.

wb-fb-1.headline: Long time no blink 💛
wb-fb-1.body: Blink Eye is still free, still open source, still reminding. Premium is how you keep it that way.

wb-fb-2.headline: The kettle's on
wb-fb-2.body: Pull up a chair and take a proper break. Premium extras are waiting whenever you'd like them.
